text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well, cake's a must, and then pizza,<n>pasta, curry,
and hamburg steaks<n>would be nice too.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, don't forget 'bout the sushi!<n>Can't have a
celebration without it!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Then how about we make our own<n>sushi rolls? If
we get a bunch of<n>ingredients, it'll be fun. What
else...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Uh, before we get ahead of ourselves,<n>isn't this
gonna be a bit much?<n>Maybe your birthday might
be a good<n>time to practice some self-control.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's the matter, Oguri? Not a<n>peep outta the
birthday girl?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Are you perhaps not feeling well? You<n>shouldn't
push yourself.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No, it's just... Seeing you two rack<n>your brains over
something like this<n>just for me, I get this feeling in
my<n>chest...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, it's almost like I've just had a<n>filling meal. I
feel content.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oguri... We're going to make lots and<n>lots of
food—just you wait!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Gah! All right, no more talk of<n>self-control from me!
Go wild!
